law: Closures are TIGHTEN-ONLY: evaluated after the frozen decision table, they may move VALID to a defect class and may never weaken or reorder a frozen classification. Each closure states the caller-supplied consistency it enforces. Operators are the frozen predicate vocabulary plus PROJECTION_NE and DERIVED_DIFF_NE (defined in rr_api.py).

OBL-30.statement: compatible_record_ids must equal the set of record_ids whose supplied compatibility verdict is true; a projection that contradicts its own verdict rows is a conflict, not a valid selection basis.
incompatible_record_ids must equal the set of record_ids whose supplied compatibility verdict is false.

undispositioned_compatible_record_ids must equal compatible_record_ids minus selected_record_ids minus excluded_record_ids — derived, never trusted: a stale selected set can no longer pass with empty caller-asserted bookkeeping.
